title: Career Roadmap: Archaeologist (after PG)
summary: Career Domain: Psychology, Humanities & Social Sciences · Qualification Pathway: BA – History · Target Career: Archaeologist (after PG)

about.label: About this roadmap
about.text: This roadmap was drafted with AI assistance from OneGrasp's related roadmaps and is awaiting expert review. Check fees, dates, eligibility and exam patterns on the official websites before you rely on them.

blocks.text: An Archaeologist studies the human past through the things people left behind - sites, tools, pottery, inscriptions and buildings. Archaeologist posts (for example at the Archaeological Survey of India) need a postgraduate degree; a BA in History is the starting point.

items.text: Archaeological Survey of India and state archaeology departments
Study ancient and medieval Indian history
Visit monuments and museums with notes
Take archaeology or ancient history electives
Learn about excavation methods and dating
Volunteer on an excavation or survey if possible
Do a project on a local site or monument
Apply for MA Archaeology / Ancient History

blocks.label: Note
blocks.text: Archaeologist posts need a PG in archaeology or ancient history; ASI's Institute of Archaeology runs a PG Diploma in Archaeology.
